results.title: Anomaly-based threat detection in smart health using machine ...
results.content: By calculating anomaly scores and validating clustering through metrics like the Silhouette Score and Dunn Score, we enhanced the capacity to secure sensitive healthcare data evolving digital threats. Three variations of Isolation Forest (IForest)models (SVM, Decision Tree, and Random Forest) and three variations of Local Outlier Factor (LOF) models (SVM, Decision Tree, and Random Forest) are evaluated based on accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, and F1 Score. This study aims to enhance healthcare data security by utilizing machine learning techniques to strengthen Electronic Health Records against inside threats. Anomaly detection through AI in smart healthcare can detect unusual patterns in data, alerting providers to potential health issues in real time, ultimately enhancing patient care and cutting costs. The Isolation Forest is a tree-based algorithm for detecting anomalies, and the isolation score revolves around isolation depth, at the same time LOF utilizes scoring methods based on densities compared to proximal neighbors.

results.title: A secure framework for the Internet of Things anomalies using ...
results.content: This study presents a robust IoT anomaly detection framework utilizing four machine learning algorithms, achieving detection accuracies between 91% and 98%, with the Classification and Regression Trees (CART) model demonstrating the highest performance, thereby enhancing the security and reliability of IoT systems. This Paper proposes a secure IoT anomaly detection framework by utilising four machine learning algorithms such as: Logistic Regression (LR), Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA), Classification and Regression Trees (CART), and Gaussian Naive Bayes (GNB). A secure IoT framework uses ML models (LR, LDA, CART, GNB) to detect anomalies in sensor data. Explain the IoT-based anomaly detection model and the Machine Learning data analytics process in detail. It looks at the impact of the problem, the related anomaly detection methods, the Internet of Things (IoT), machine learning models and methods, and the security framework. The IoT anomaly detection model uses CART algorithms to test unlabelled authentication data with 2675 records. The proposed framework builds on existing research in IoT anomaly detection by incorporating lightweight machine learning models and AWS-based infrastructure.
